courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 巴黎 RER A 線
related.transfer: 可遷移「里程融合與不確定度」與「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巴黎 RER A 線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Position fusion and uncertainty" and "Tunnel air exchange and dilution time" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Paris RER Line A must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦都市穿越線多介面控制與地下車站；巴黎 RER A 線則以都會區域幹線分支合流與尖峰人流為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on urban cross-city control interfaces and underground stations; Paris RER Line A centres on metropolitan regional branches merging and peak passenger flow, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「里程融合與不確定度」與「快慢車追及與待避」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巴黎 RER A 線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「折返作業與路徑占用」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Position fusion and uncertainty” and “Fast-slow train catch-up”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Paris RER Line A, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Turnback and route occupation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 倫敦伊莉莎白線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2021 年：伊莉莎白線開始試運轉並進入試營運階段；2022 年：伊莉莎白線中央區段於五月開放旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以倫敦伊莉莎白線連接既有鐵路與新建中央隧道的情境為背景，建立多運轉區段的教學案例。課程把定位、通訊、車門及轉乘人流串成事件鏈，要求先證明每個邊界的允許狀態，再討論端到端班距與乘客便利。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2021: The Elizabeth line began trial running and progressed into trial operations; 2022: The Elizabeth line central section opened to passengers in May. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Elizabeth line’s connection of existing railways through a new central tunnel as the setting for a multi-section teaching case. Link localisation, communication, doors and interchange flows in an event chain. Establish permissible states at each boundary before discussing end-to-end headway or passenger convenience, and explicitly distinguish test readiness from the commencement of revenue service. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.
